nodes.name: Qualify Call
nodes.notes:
One string input, not a mapped object. Sub-workflow inputs flatten nested data
unpredictably and a lead carries its original payload, so the whole record crosses
the boundary as JSON text and is parsed once on this side.

nodes.name: Enrich Company
nodes.notes:
EDGE CASE 3, and the one place in this build where n8n's built-in retry is the
right tool. The enrichment provider reports failure honestly through its status
code (429, 500, timeout), so retryOnFail can see it. Odoo does not - it answers
HTTP 200 on failure - which is why LP-90 hand-rolls its retry loop and this node
does not need to.

Timeout 8s against a 3-try budget: a hung provider costs at most ~30s, well inside
the workflow timeout, and this path is asynchronous anyway - nobody is waiting.

continueRegularOutput because enrichment is an ENHANCEMENT. A lead that cannot be
enriched must still be scored and routed; failing the lead because a third party
was down would be the pipeline punishing the customer for the vendor.

Reproduce the failure: append ?fail=timeout&times=2 to the URL, and the third
attempt succeeds.

nodes.name: No Enrichment
nodes.notes:
A skipped enrichment is not a failed one, and the difference is recorded. Sending
a person who asked not to be contacted to a data vendor would be a privacy
incident, not an optimisation.

nodes.name: AI Classify

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  model: $json.cfg.ai_model,
  temperature: 0,
  max_tokens: 300,
  response_format: { type: "json_object" },
  messages: [
    { role: "system", content: "You classify inbound B2B sales enquiries for an automation consultancy. Return ONE JSON object and nothing else.

Schema:
{"intent_level":"high|medium|low","urgency":"immediate|this_quarter|exploring|unknown","buying_signals":["short phrase"],"objections":["short phrase"],"reason":"under 200 characters","confidence":0.0}

Rules:
- Judge only what is written. Never infer a company, a budget, a timeline or a job title that is not in the text.
- buying_signals and objections must be phrases the writer actually used. At most 3 and 2. Empty arrays are correct when there are none.
- reason must quote the words that decided it.
- If the text is too short or too vague to judge, use intent_level "low" and confidence 0.3 or less.
- confidence is your certainty in this classification, not how interested the lead is." },
    { role: "user", content: "Source: " + $json.lead.source + "
Service asked for: " + ($json.lead.service_interest || "not stated") + "
Company: " + ($json.lead.company || "not stated") + "

What they wrote:
" + $json.lead.free_text }
  ]
}) }}

nodes.notes:
The prompt withholds the deterministic score ON PURPOSE. Show a model the number
it is being checked against and it will agree with it, and the conflict detector
then measures anchoring rather than disagreement.

temperature 0 and response_format json_object: this is a classifier, not a writer.
max_tokens 300 caps both the spend and the blast radius of a rambling answer.

Cost at the model's list price ($0.10/1M in, $0.40/1M out) and this prompt size:
roughly $0.09 per 1,000 classified leads, and only leads with real free text are
classified at all.

continueRegularOutput: edge case 4. An unavailable model must degrade the lead to
rules-only, never block it.

nodes.name: Parse AI
nodes.notes:
EDGE CASE 4 in full: an empty response, prose instead of JSON, a fenced block, an
out-of-vocabulary value and a non-numeric confidence all resolve to the same safe
fallback with ai_status="unavailable" - and the reason is recorded, so "the AI is
not working" is a diagnosable statement rather than a feeling.

The AI NEVER contributes points, so the fallback changes the score by exactly
zero. That is the payoff for keeping the two axes independent.

nodes.name: Write Qualification Audit

value.detail_json: ={{ JSON.stringify({ score: $json.score, rule_band: $json.rule_band, reason: $json.band_reason, breakdown: JSON.parse($json.score_breakdown_json), enrichment: $json.enrich_status, ai: { status: $json.ai_status, intent: $json.ai_intent, confidence: $json.ai_confidence, reason: $json.ai_reason, note: $json.ai_note } }) }}

nodes.notes:
The whole breakdown is written, not just the total. "Why did this lead get 62?"
is answered by reading one row, which is the difference between a score a
salesperson trusts and a score they route around.

nodes.name: Handoff to Route
nodes.notes:
Not waited on. If LP-03 fails, exactly one dead letter is raised - by LP-03,
naming LP-03. Waiting would propagate the failure back up and produce a second
dead letter for the same incident, which is how an error inbox becomes noise.

parameters.content:
## LP-02 Qualify

**Decides. Never acts.** No Odoo write, no message, no assignment - LP-03 owns every side effect. So this workflow is safe to re-run as many times as you like.

**Two independent axes.** The 0-100 score comes from structured fields only; the model reads the free text and contributes **zero points**. Delete the AI half and every lead still scores, bands and routes.

**The model is not shown the score** - otherwise "conflict detection" would just be measuring how well it anchors to a number it was handed.

**Conflict = band distance >= 2 AND confidence >= 0.7** -> a human looks (EC-5). Adjacent disagreement is logged and ignored, or the review queue becomes the default path.

Enrichment down (EC-3) or model down (EC-4): the lead still completes, rules-only, with the reason recorded.
